d: Takshashila men alakshendr apni pratha anusar bali charha kar takshashila ke 5000 nivasiyon aur pradhano dvara gathit sena ke sath aage barha aur jhelam nadi ke tat par parav dala - nadi ke dusre tat par pauras apne hathiyon va vishal sena ke sath upasthit tha. jise dekh alakshendr ne aage na barhne ka nirnay liya magar vo thahra ek yunani - aur phir usne dusri ranniti apnayi - kya kiya tha alakshendr ne jisse ki usne pauras ki vishal sena ko parajit kar pauras ko bandi bana liya? dekhie iss bhag men.
